Pass 40 (built green): bulk-haul heavy-stack fallback; cross-level RMB null-coalesce; equal storage-priority never crosses; vanilla haulability parity (chunks need Orders->Haul designation); and NEW multi-hop cross-level hauling - a stack whose only accepting storage is 2+ levels away is now carried gap-by-gap and stored at the FIRST accepting level.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## TESTING RULE (USER DIRECTIVE 2026-07-25)
**NEVER launch tests with the user's full modlist (isolated=false).** ALWAYS isolated=true with a minimal companionMods set (Dubwise.DubsBadHygiene for DBH, Krkr.rule56 for CAI, Mehni.PickUpAndHaul for bulk-haul) + build a fresh column via the dev action "As above\\AB: ensure sky + basement". NOTE: the auto-PIN of that palette entry can log "Could not find node from path ... Removing." at startup (pin loads before debug actions register) - the action still exists in the debug menu; run it manually. Non-isolated only if the user explicitly asks.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY only sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB.
- Selection survives column view switches AND pawn level-changes. All levels real maps; viewing swaps Find.CurrentMap. Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir + AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop.
- **See-below = RENDER overlay + per-interaction input hooks, NOT a general see-through.**
- **Designators OUT OF SCOPE (pass 33).**
- Logistics doctrine: every ferry MONOTONE. Storage=vanilla+capacity clamp + delivered-level retention (pass 34).
- **WORK doctrine (pass 36): the column is ONE BIG MAP for work priority.**
- **HAULING / STORAGE-PRIORITY doctrine (pass 37, REFINED p40):** ONE BIG MAP for storage priority, but a cross-level storage move fires ONLY when the destination tier STRICTLY beats the best storage the item can reach on its OWN level. Equal (or lower) priority never crosses. Explicit intent (Allow Tool Haul Urgently -> ignorePins) still crosses. Monotone.
- **HAULABILITY PARITY doctrine (p40):** cross-level auto-haul mirrors vanilla. A NON-alwaysHaulable thing (stone/slag chunk) is only auto-hauled when DESIGNATED (Orders -> Haul) or already in storage; corpses are alwaysHaulable and unaffected. Enforced in TargetLevelFor AND CrossLevelHaulChain.
- **MULTI-HOP HAULING doctrine (p40, user directive 2026-07-26 "stop at first level that accepts it"):** a stack whose only accepting storage is 2+ levels away is carried gap-by-gap and stored at the NEAREST (fewest hops) level that accepts it. Greedy: at each landing, store here if this level accepts, else take the next hop; if storage filled mid-transit, drop (self-heals). The origin level never accepts it (else it would store locally), so the chain cannot bounce back.
- **COMBAT doctrine:** spawn projectiles on the TARGET map. **VISUALS (p38): real 1:1 projectile.** **FoW (p39): optional CAI 5000.**
- **Soft-compat HARD RULE (p35):** foreign types never in a SIGNATURE/field. CAI reflection-only.
- **RE-ENTRANCY HARD RULE (p40):** when we RE-ENTER a vanilla method we also patch, a foreign prefix may SKIP the original and leave nulls; coalesce at the boundary.

# PASS 40 — HAUL/MENU FIX WAVE (BUILT GREEN 0/0, pending in-game verify)
**FIX 1 — bulk-haul heavy-stack loop:** `CrossLevelHaulJob.Build` bulk-loads only when `CountToPickUpUntilOverEncumbered(seed) > 0`, else single carry; bulk driver stops gathering once a visit lifts nothing (`lastPickupOk`). NOTE stone chunks are mass 25 so a fresh colonist still bulk-loads ~3; this only diverts genuinely-too-heavy/already-loaded pawns.
**FIX 2 — cross-level RMB red error (Melee Animation NRE):** our GetOptions prefix re-enters GetOptions; a foreign prefix skipped the original leaving list+context null -> Melee's postfix NREs on the null `__result`. Coalesce the re-entrant result+context (in `BuildOptions` and at the prefix boundary).
**FIX 3 — equal-tier storage never crosses:** `TargetLevelFor` discards any non-`beatsLocal` storage verdict unless `ignorePins`.
**FIX 4 — vanilla HAULABILITY PARITY for chunks:** `TargetLevelFor` (and CrossLevelHaulChain) reject a non-alwaysHaulable thing unless DESIGNATED (Orders->Haul) or in storage. Mirrors `ListerHaulables.ShouldBeHaulable`. Before, the fast haul check skipped that gate.
**FIX 5 — MULTI-HOP CROSS-LEVEL HAULING (NEW, user report: "pawns do not haul across 2 levels; they do haul from basement to ground level"):** ROOT CAUSE: `TargetLevelFor` only checked directly-adjacent maps (`comp.upperMap`/`comp.lowerMap`) and stairs only link adjacent levels (`CounterpartTowards` returns null for a 2-gap jump), so a basement chunk whose only stockpile is on the sky (surface bare in between) was never discovered/hauled. NEW `Source/Logistics/CrossLevelHaulChain.cs`: `TryStartFarHaul` (coarse whole-column `LevelAcceptsItem` scan at distance 2, strictly-better-than-bestLocal, same haulability gate) is called by the two LOW-priority givers (`WorkGiver_ABHaulAcrossLevels`, `WorkGiver_ABBulkHaulAcrossLevels`) when `TargetLevelFor` returns null. It issues `AB_HaulChainAcrossLevels` (new JobDef, SAME driver `JobDriver_HaulAcrossLevels` with `Chain==true`). The driver's transfer toil arms an `ABPendingOrders` callback -> `CrossLevelHaulChain.OnArrive`, which per landing: (a) `HaulToStorageJob` stores here if this level accepts (first accepting level), else (b) `FindNextHop` (nearest accepting level any direction/distance) issues the next `AB_HaulChainAcrossLevels` hop (pickup skipped via `AlreadyCarryingTarget` jump since the item rides in-hand), else (c) drop (self-heal). Single-hop `AB_HaulAcrossLevels` path is UNTOUCHED (Chain==false). Cap-3 bounds the chain. Open/verify: perf of the coarse far-scan per-chunk (bounded by slot-group count; only chunk-accepting groups scan cells); pathological ping-pong (guarded by origin-never-accepts, not by stored direction).

# PASS 39 — OPTIONAL CAI 5000 (Krkr.rule56): FOG OF WAR + CROSS-LEVEL VISION (phases 1-3 built green, pending verify)
# PASS 38 COMBAT VISUALS · 37 STORAGE-PRIORITY HAUL · 36 ONE-BIG-MAP WORK (VERIFIED) · 36b AIM POSE (VERIFIED) · 36c MODDED TURRET · 35 DBH/GRAVSHIP/DELETE/LEVELGEN · 34 HARDENING · 33 SEE-BELOW INPUT (VERIFIED)

## Modern Dev Tools integration — SHIPPED About/known-issues.json (inert without MDT).

## REMOVED FEATURES
SKYLIGHTS (r7). MOUNTAIN RIVERS + WATERFALLS (r12). Stairwell heat exchange (2026-07-21). CROSS-LEVEL TRACERS (p38). Equal-tier lateral cross-level storage moves (p40). Auto-haul of UNDESIGNATED loose chunks (p40).

## VERIFIED (USER)
RMB cross-level · basement · Batch A · mech charge · bill supply + mech RMB · p33 see-below input · p36 work priority · p36b aim pose.

## FEATURE LEDGER
RMB 1:1 (VERIFIED) · basement (VERIFIED) · haul/ferry (p37 storage-priority; **p40 strictly-better-only + vanilla haulability gate + MULTI-HOP chain**; bulk heavy-stack fallback p40) · below lighting · animal flows · mech charge (VERIFIED) · elevation/drag-box/targeter/hover (VERIFIED) · selection-across-stairs (p33) · one-big-map work (p36, VERIFIED) · aim pose (p36b, VERIFIED) · modded turret fire (p36c) · combat visuals (p38) · CAI 5000 p1-3 (p39) · cross-level RMB re-entrancy coalesce (p40) · MDT known-issues.json. OUT OF SCOPE: cross-level designators, non-projectile turrets, feeding CAI threat-AI across the gap.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE · Biomes! Caverns · Alpha Biomes · BM+MO · Odyssey+VLE · Misc. Robots/++ · **Pick Up And Haul / Hauler's Dream (bulk cross-level haul; heavy-stack fallback p40; far chain is single-item)** · Allow Tool (Haul Urgently bypasses strictly-better + designation gates) · Ancient urban ruins · CE (p38) · Achtung!/Reverse/Giddy-up/Vehicle Framework/Windows/Declutter/Animal Tab/Colonist Bar KF · Trader Airships, Hospitality · BAM · PO/Dubs Analyzer/TPT · WVC Work Modes · Stratum · Sand & Snow Coverage · Modern Dev Tools · Perspective: Ores · CAI 5000 / Krkr.rule56 (p39) · Melee Animation / Float Sub-Menus / other GetOptions-patching mods (p40 coalesce) · turrets: any Building_Turret w/ projectile verb (p36c) · INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta, Strata · UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded, non-projectile/CE-verb turrets across levels.

## STANDING TEST QUEUE (run ISOLATED + dev-built column)
**PASS 40 (TOP):**
- FIX 5 (multi-hop, the current report): 3-level column. Designate loose chunks on the BASEMENT (Orders->Haul), chunk stockpile ONLY on the SKY/upper (surface has NO chunk storage) -> pawns must carry chunks basement->surface->sky and deposit in the sky stockpile. Add a chunk stockpile on the SURFACE too -> chunks must now STOP at the surface (first accepting level), not continue to the sky. Watch for drops/loops/perf.
- FIX 4 (haulability): undesignated loose chunks are LEFT; designating them (Orders->Haul) makes them haul. FIX 3: equal-priority stockpiles on two levels -> nearest/local wins, no cross; raise one higher -> crosses. FIX 1 (Mehni.PickUpAndHaul): no walk-no-pickup loop. FIX 2 (co.uk.epicguru.meleeanimation): cross-level RMB no red error.
**PASS 39 CAI 5000** (Krkr.rule56). **38 · 37 · 36c · 35** queues.

## DEV DIAGNOSTIC SUITE
AB: ensure sky+basement · basement/light/RMB/below-view diagnostics · cross-gap combat / auto-engage / targeting-hub self-tests · CAI fog self-test (p39).

## Status
2026-07-26 (pass 40, BUILT GREEN 0/0, pending in-game verify): FIVE haul/menu fixes. (1) bulk-haul heavy-stack fallback; (2) cross-level RMB red-error null-coalesce (Melee Animation); (3) equal storage-priority never crosses; (4) vanilla haulability parity (chunks need Orders->Haul designation); (5) NEW multi-hop cross-level hauling - `CrossLevelHaulChain` carries a stack gap-by-gap to the NEAREST level that accepts it (new AB_HaulChainAcrossLevels job on the existing driver, greedy per-landing store-or-hop via ABPendingOrders; single-hop path untouched), fixing "pawns do not haul across 2 levels". Testing ISOLATED + dev column; PUAH + Melee Animation companions.
